# Zixu

> Zixu is an open-source posture log and daily exercise planner for adults living with scoliosis. It turns a two-minute check-in into a short, conservative routine, stops on red flags, and does not diagnose or treat.

## Status
- The English version is in preparation; the waitlist is open: {{BASE_URL}}/#waitlist
- A Chinese version is live at https://body.liang111.top (web and Android).

## What it does
- Daily check-in: back discomfort from 0 to 10, energy, and the minutes available.
- A short routine of low-load exercises, each with its own stop rules.
- No routine on a day with red flags: numbness or tingling in the legs, pain shooting down a leg, new weakness, changes in bladder or bowel control, sudden sharp back pain.
- If discomfort is clearly higher after a session, the next one can be made lighter or turned into a rest day.
- Posture photos taken the same way each time, compared side by side.

## What it does not do
- It does not diagnose scoliosis, measure the Cobb angle, or promise any change to the curve.
- It is not for children or teenagers.
